messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page PDR-8142 fired for inference-queue-surge-eu (sev2). Automated page to #incidents. Link: https://pd.internal/PDR-8142 :rotating_light:

sam: oncall here, claiming. I'll ack in PD now.

pagerduty: sam acknowledged incident PDR-8142

mike: @sam quick FYI — any customer-facing errors? saw spikes of 502s in eu-embedder metrics.

sam: seeing elevated queue length on eu-embedder, prefix/KV queue piling. ~90th pct requests queued >2000ms. Spiking 5xx on embed endpoint. Running quick checks.

alex: if it's OOM/scale, can we failover traffic to dedicated-us as a temporary fallback? what's ETA to flip?

sam: trying to scale pods now: `kubectl scale deployment/emb-eu --replicas=6` — new pods getting ImagePullBackOff on a subset of nodes. Quick status: 
```
kubectl get pods -l app=emb-eu
NAME                       READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
emb-eu-1                   1/1     Running            0          2h
emb-eu-2                   0/1     ImagePullBackOff   0          10s
emb-eu-3                   0/1     ImagePullBackOff   0          8s
```

jenny: pinging infra team /oncall-infra to check node pool capacity and image registry flaps. Also preparing routing fallback: /ops/fallback enable eu->us (canary).

mike: can you confirm customer impact scope? which routes/customers hit 502s?

sam: initial look: embeddings API (v1/embeddings) saw ~2% failures for EU origin customers in last 5m. Reroute started for high-latency prefixes as canary — will monitor.

pagerduty: Reminder: escalation to senior oncall in 15m if not resolved. :alarm_clock:

alex: @jenny please coordinate with infra to lift node quota; @sam drop a short incident stub in the docs with timeline.

sam: created incident doc https://docs.internal/incidents/PDR-8142 and added timeline + mitigations (canary reroute, scale attempts).

jenny: infra says autoscaler hit quota for EU nodepool — requesting manual node add. Est 8-12 minutes to boot and join.

mike: great — keep updates every 5m. If fallback fully mitigates, note for postmortem and client comms.

sam: update: canary reroute looks good — queue length trending down and error rate dropped to ~0.8%. Continuing to watch.

jenny: manual nodes provisioning started (request id req-9923). I'll update once nodes join and image pull issue is investigated.

sam: handing initial ownership to jenny for infra+RCA follow-up. I'm unclaiming now. @jenny you're the owner.

jenny: ack — taking ownership for follow-up and RCA. will post update when nodes are healthy and fallback turned off. :thumbsup:

incidentbot: Incident PDR-8142 acknowledged by sam, owner changed to jenny. Page temporarily un-suppressed.
